items.quote: Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Allgemeinen Musterkasse erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Fri 20 Dec 2024, sent by ordinary post. Per the letter's own rule and § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, it counts as notified (bekannt gegeben) on the 3rd day after posting = Mon 23 Dec 2024. The one-month objection period starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB, § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X) and ends one month later on the same-numbered day (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): Thu 23 Jan 2025. That day is a normal working day in NW (no shift needed under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X).

warnings: The letter states a 3-day deemed-delivery rule for postal notices (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X); this was applied assuming the letter was actually posted on its printed date (20 Dec 2024) — if it was posted later, the deadline would shift accordingly.
